articles.title: RIP: Marcia Lucas, Oscar-Winning Star Wars Editor, Dies at 80
articles.summary: Marcia, a crucial member of a three-person editing crew, played a pivotal role in shaping the iconic "Star Wars" and "Return of the Jedi" films. Working alongside Paul Hirsch and Richard Chew on the original "Star Wars," her significant personal contributions as an editor were fundamental to the saga's success and cinematic impact, demonstrating the artistry in post-production.

articles.title: Green Lantern Lore Officially Debuts Superman's Exact Opposite
articles.summary: DC Comics introduces a new character whose origin story parallels Superman's, yet features a unique twist linking them to real-world Earth history. This addition expands the intricate DC multiverse, exploring how iconic figures might manifest across various timelines. The narrative aims to deepen DC's foundational lore by integrating historical contexts into a superhero's mythos, providing a fresh perspective on established universes.
